title: Verify Codex extraction semantics on a real Mac
description:
Pin from a real Mac: the exact harness-injected user-role content markers (instruction and environment wrappers riding along as user items) in the current codex-cli version; whether event_msg user_message kind (for example plain) reliably distinguishes genuinely typed input; the forked_from_id / forked_from_ordinal_exclusive skip semantics on real resumed rollouts; whether compressed rollouts appear on disk in normal CLI use (skip-with-note if so). Record findings.

Done when: each semantic is confirmed or corrected from real rollouts and encoded into synthetic fixtures; findings record the evidence.
